Customer Engagement : Guide clients through the onboarding process, ensuring seamless integration with Fireblocks’ MPC-based Wallet Infrastructure and APIs. Work with leading financial institutions, fintechs, and Web3 innovators at the forefront of digital asset adoption. Be part of a collaborative team driving the future of blockchain infrastructure. items.title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer, you will partner directly with Digital Native companies to design, build and deploy AI-powered products and systems. Working alongside customer product and engineering teams, you will take ideas from early experimentation through evaluation, production launch and scale, connecting technical decisions to user experience and measurable business impact. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: - Partner directly with Digital Native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria. - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes. - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators. - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution. - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact. - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback. - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. You’ll thrive in this role if you: - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting. - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering—not only program or stakeholder management. - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable. - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment. - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost. - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives. - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments. - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.title: Identity & Access Management Lead
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME🎮 As a member of the SecOps team within Defensive Security, you will build and lead a cross-functional Identity and Access Management (IAM) capability from the ground up. You will define the vision, establish the foundations and coordinate the teams and processes needed to manage identities and access across multiple environments and tenants, including Active Directory, Entra ID and Okta. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC🔥 In this role, your main missions will be to: Strategy, organization, governance · Assess the existing IAM landscape , including directories, applications, identity data, access models, provisioning workflows and integrations; identify technical gaps, risks and implementation dependencies. · Define the IAM strategy, governance framework, target architecture and roadmap , translating requirements into technical designs and implementation plans (covering configuration, integrations, data and entitlement mapping, migration, testing and deployment) · Partner with IT, business and security teams to define access requirements and controls for workforce, privileged and service accounts. · Establish identity lifecycle processes with HR and IT, covering joiners, movers, leavers and role changes; · Design and implement an Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) framework, including role and entitlement models, access reviews, ownership and segregation of duties. · Promote IAM best practices and clarify access management responsibilities across the organisation. Architecture and technical solutions · Lead the end-to-end implementation of IAM and IGA solution, workflows and controls , from design and integration through deployment and operational handover, including access requests, approvals, provisioning, access changes, reviews and deprovisioning. · Define the access control model, including RBAC and ABAC approaches, entitlement mapping, access bundles, and rules for exceptional or time-bound access. · Design and oversee lifecycle automation across applications and directories · Lead the integration and evolution of IAM solutions across environments such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and Okta. · Evaluate external IGA and IAM solutions. · Define multi-tenant standards and IAM governance, including operating processes, application and role ownership, and control monitoring. · Establish performance indicators and drive continuous improvement. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! You have at least 5 years of experience in IAM or cybersecurity, including significant experience leading cross-functional projects or programmes. You have built or significantly improved an IAM or IGA capability in a complex, multi-entity or multi-tenant environment. You have experience with identity platforms and directories such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and/or Okta. You understand identity lifecycle management, access governance, role and entitlement models, access certification and segregation of duties. You have practical knowledge of identity integration and provisioning standards, including SCIM 2.0, SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and OAuth 2.0. You understand authentication and access control concepts, including single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), privileged access management (PAM) and service or non-human identities. You can work effectively with HR, IT, business and security teams, translating business processes into secure and practical identity controls. You have strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, and can prioritise work across a broad stakeholder landscape. You are proactive, adaptable and comfortable building a new capability in an evolving technical and business context. You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. And finally, you speak English fluently WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS?📝 If your application is shortlisted, Maxime will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). Next, you will have a technical interview with Jean-Luc, Senior Defensive Cybersecurity Manager, and a technical expert. You will then meet with Sophie, Global Security Director. Finally, Maxime will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?🎁 ✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic) 🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport) 🏡 Hybrid work model 📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year 🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin 🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life 🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) Permanent contract, available immediately in Bordeaux (remote from another city possible depending on profile - on-site presence required twice a month)Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude Frontier Academy is where organizations nominate their strongest people to build deep, hands-on skills with Claude. Backed by a $100 million commitment, Anthropic aims to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027. The Academy’s first program, the Frontier Deployed Engineer (FDE) Residency, brings engineers from leading customers and partners together in cohorts, and more programs will follow. We’re looking for a Marketing Lead to make the Academy a name the market knows and a credential people are proud to earn. As the Academy’s first dedicated marketer, you’ll own how it shows up in the world. You’re a creative, versatile marketer who thinks in terms of brand and communications and also knows how to position, launch, and grow programs. You’ll turn each program launch into a major market moment, celebrate milestones like new cohorts and the first badges earned, and build a community of graduates who help tell the story. Because the Academy serves both partners and customers, this role will sit on our Partner Marketing team. You’ll work directly with partners and customers to secure their participation in announcements and bring them into our launch and amplification plans. You’ll help shape the Academy’s strategy and annual plan and represent marketing with senior leaders, while staying hands-on enough to write the first draft yourself. Partners and customers already engage with other Anthropic education and training programs, so you’ll be thoughtful about how the Academy fits alongside them. If you’ve built a branded program at a B2B technology company and want to do it again at a much bigger scale, this role is for you. Key responsibilities Own the marketing strategy and annual plan for Claude Frontier Academy and its programs, working with Academy leadership to set priorities and goals Build and maintain a calendar of market moments for the Academy and each program, including program launches, new cohorts, and badge milestones Lead launches end to end, from messaging and announcement drafts through legal and executive review, launch-day execution and post-launch amplification Partner with Communications on press releases and announcements, including sourcing customer and partner quotes and securing approval to use their names Align early with Partnerships, Communications, and Account Teams on which customers and partners are named in each announcement, who gets a heads-up before it goes live, and how to answer those who aren’t named Develop amplification plans with partners and customers across social posts, blogs, newsletters, and their own announcements, and turn cohort results into joint customer and partner stories Grow the Academy’s presence on LinkedIn and other social channels with content that showcases programs, cohorts, and graduates Own the Academy’s web presence and any paid promotion, working with our web team and with creative and agency partners Build a community program that keeps cohort members and badge holders connected and turns them into advocates for the Academy Work with Brand to extend the Academy’s naming and brand architecture as new programs launch, keeping it consistent with, and clearly distinct from, Anthropic’s other education and training offerings Learn Anthropic’s other education and training programs, such as Claude Academy, Claude certifications, and Partner Basecamp, and work with their teams to define where Claude Frontier Academy fits, where the programs connect, and how they reference each other, so partners and customers see one clear path Equip Account Teams and Partner Account Managers with FAQs, internal announcements, and guidance so they can answer questions, help customers and partners register their interest, and set clear expectations on participation Keep senior stakeholders aligned through regular status updates and clear recommendations, and define and report on success metrics for Academy marketing Minimum qualifications Have built and run branded B2B marketing programs at a software/SaaS technology company, such as customer education, certification, community, or user conference programs Have marketed education, training, or certification programs at a technology company, such as a partner, customer, or developer academy Bring a creative, brand-minded approach and know how to create market moments that get noticed Have led major launches or announcements, coordinating press, social, and partner amplification, and keeping everyone aligned through legal review, executive edits, and date changes Know how to build an audience and spark conversation on LinkedIn and other social channels with B2B audiences Have strong executive presence and are comfortable giving updates and making recommendations to senior leaders Can operate at both strategic and tactical levels, comfortable owning an annual plan and rolling up your sleeves to ship Build trusted relationships with partners, customers, and cross-functional teams, and can drive approvals and commitments without formal authority Are an excellent writer who can move easily between press releases, FAQs, and social posts Are energized by ambiguity and by building something new as a first-in-seat marketer Passionate about AI diffusion and bringing the benefits of AI to people and the world Preferred qualifications 8+ years of B2B software marketing experience spanning brand, communications, or program marketing Experience building community or advocacy programs where members promote the program themselves Experience marketing to technical audiences, particularly engineers and developers Experience running joint announcements with global system integrators, consulting firms, or enterprise customers Experience marketing to enterprise technology leaders, such as CIOs and CTOs Experience marketing AI/ML products Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco office at least 2 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. items.location_text: Paris, Palo Alto, Amsterdam, Linz, Munich, London, Berlin
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE TEAM You will join the AI4Engineering Science team, the Mistral research group that builds the data and evaluation infrastructure and owns the SFT/RL processes for AI4Engineering that teach our frontier LLMs to do real engineering work. The agentic engineering group works alongside the Physics AI research in the wider Science organisation. This seat sits in the agentic CAD stream. Together with the Solutions and Applied teams, the group carries this work into customer projects with industrial partners in automotive, aerospace, semiconductors, and beyond. THE ROLE Mistral is looking for an AI Scientist with deep machine learning expertise and hands-on CAD experience to expand what our agentic tools can do for computer-aided design. Your focus is a single mission: teaching Mistral's LLMs to generate, analyze, and modify CAD designs the way an expert design engineer would. Your core work is building the pre- and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real CAD tasks: text-to-CAD and image-to-CAD generation from technical drawings, geometric analysis and QA of CAD parts, and modification of existing designs. Because Mistral trains its own frontier LLMs, the data and verifiers you design ship directly into models you can hold - a rare position, and the core of the job. Alongside this, you will help shape the agent architectures and harnesses that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step CAD workflows, driving CAD tools through APIs or computer use across the whole design loop. This is early-stage work, and that's the point: you are joining at the foundation, shaping the data, verifiers, and agent scaffolding that decide whether these systems become reliable or stay demo-grade. There is no inherited playbook; you will help define what good looks like, and your work will set the direction the CAD stream builds on rather than extend an existing one. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design pretraining, SFT, and RL data for CAD tasks: text-to-CAD and image-to-CAD generation from technical drawings, geometric analysis and QA of CAD parts, and design modification - Define verifiers and evaluation criteria that capture what "correct" and "high-quality" actually mean for CAD tasks - Scale the data pipelines that produce agentic CAD training traces - Design and improve agent architectures and harnesses: how models plan, call CAD tools via API or computer use, recover from errors, and chain steps together across long-horizon design workflows - Build and maintain CAD evaluation benchmarks and diagnostic tooling, from parametric CAD and drawing-to-3D benchmarks to industrial evaluations, identifying where models fail and tracing those failures back to gaps in data, reward design, or agent scaffolding - Collaborate with CAD domain experts and the CAE and EDA streams (and the science and solutions teams more broadly) to identify which CAD workflows are highest-value to target next - Contribute to Mistral's broader pre- and post-training research, sharing findings and methodology across the science organization WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Deep, hands-on machine learning expertise, particularly LLM development: you have built LLM training pipelines (SFT, RL, fine-tuning, GRPO), demonstrated in publications or shipped systems rather than CV claims - Demonstrated hands-on CAD experience: you have designed, scripted, or automated real CAD workflows in tools such as SolidWorks, CATIA, Siemens NX, FreeCAD, or CADQuery, ideally with CAD-kernel grounding (OpenCASCADE, build123d) - Fluent English with excellent communication skills: you can explain technical ML and CAD concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences - You write clean, readable Python code and are comfortable in Linux/HPC environments - Self-directed: you do not need detailed roadmaps to make progress - Low-ego, collaborative, and eager to learn at the intersection of CAD and ML It would be great if you: - Have experience building or fine-tuning agentic systems (tool use, multi-step planning, agent orchestration frameworks) - Have experience with reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR, or preference-based training - Have first-author publications or open-source benchmark work in agentic CAD or CAD-ML, such as CAD generation benchmarks or RL/GRPO fine-tuning of vision-language models for CAD - Have contributed to a large open-source or industry codebase - Have publications in engineering and ML venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, JFM, AIAA, etc.) WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Anthropic Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Senior Data Center Preconstruction & Capacity Delivery Manager at Anthropic, you'll make sure our EMEA deals are ready to execute before we commit to them, and you'll take time out of every program before the lease is signed. Delivery dates and costs on AI infrastructure deals are largely fixed at signature. What is missed before then is hard to recover afterwards, and our leverage over the schedule is at its highest while the deal is still open. About 75% of your time goes to preconstruction and pre-lease management, from first desktop review through Letter of Intent (LOI) to lease execution. You'll test whether each opportunity can be delivered, rigorously accelerate its program, and shape the deal so that what a developer commits to can be held to, verified and delivered. The other 25% goes to delivery. You'll carry that work through mobilization, embed with the partners building leased and partnered capacity, and lead them to deliver on the fastest possible schedule while maintaining a safe construction site and protecting the finished quality of the data center. Our EMEA pipeline is getting off the ground, so you'll set the standard for how deals become ready for execution here. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Anthropic secures and activates the compute infrastructure needed to train and deploy frontier AI systems, working at the intersection of real estate, construction, and cutting-edge AI infrastructure. Responsibilities - preconstruction and pre-lease management (about 75%): Lead. This is a role where leadership trumps management and process. You will be expected to engage developers, contractors, utilities and our transaction teams early enough to shape the outcome of each deal rather than report on it afterwards. Confirm deal readiness and serve as the gatekeeper to validate transaction viability from LOI through lease execution, ensuring all predevelopment, planning, technical and business requirements are met before commitment Give transaction leads an early delivery view from desktop study on capacity, power, permitting, connectivity, schedule and cost, so that the sites moving to LOI are ones that can be delivered Run independent, evidence-based delivery due diligence on each opportunity, tested against source documents rather than relayed claims, covering capacity, power, permitting, connectivity, procurement, schedule, cost, and whether the developer's team, contractors and supply chain can deliver Interrogate every developer schedule from the native file rather than summary dates, testing logic, durations, production rates and critical paths, planning backwards from commissioning, and establishing the unconstrained date before any commercial protection is added Rigorously accelerate programs during the pre-lease phase by making schedule work a priority for the developer while the deal depends on it, pulling forward design, permitting, power, early works and procurement, and sequencing the build around how capacity turns up Assess contractor and supply-chain capacity and long-lead equipment needs for each opportunity, setting a long-lead strategy that secures delivery capacity ahead of need and making the case for early equipment funding where it protects a date Challenge Total Development Cost and delivery schedules against the assumptions behind Yield-on-Cost and IRR, flagging where time-to-power or cost exposure puts the investment case at risk Shape the delivery terms of the LOI, lease and supporting exhibits with transaction and legal teams, including phasing and target dates, landlord scope, diligence cost, ownership and reliance, risk allocation and governance, and check that the developer's contract with its general contractor carries the same milestones and aligns incentives around accelerated delivery Give deal and delivery leadership a clear go/no-go recommendation at each decision point up to signature, with the risks, conditions and mitigations behind it Keep one delivery-readiness record and one risk register across all EMEA opportunities, assigning every risk to an accountable owner, tracking it to resolution, and escalating where cost or schedule is threatened Direct owner's representatives and third-party advisers and assure what they produce, bringing design and engineering, cost, schedule, commercial, contracts and procurement into a single view of risk and readiness Develop and refine the preconstruction playbook, a reference log of unit costs and benchmarks, and the operating model needed to scale the function, using AI tools including Claude for first-pass assessment, document review and benchmarking so your time goes to judgment and negotiation Prepare and present regular executive reporting on readiness and risk for each opportunity and across the portfolio, including time from signature to construction start, risks found before versus after signature, and baseline-to-actual variance, supporting forward capacity planning and strategic decision-making Responsibilities - delivery leadership (about 25%): Document the baseline at signature for design, budget, schedule, long-lead position, open risks and conditions, so delivery starts from an assured position whether you carry the project forward yourself or hand it to a delivery colleague Partner with landlords and developers post-deal to serve as Anthropic's primary point of contact, coordinating across internal stakeholders, tracking construction progress, and facilitating critical information exchange between development partners and Anthropic stakeholders You will be expected to be at one or more project sites in adequate amount to shape the culture, approach, and aggressiveness that define those extended site teams. The goal is to impact outcomes in a favorable manner. You are expected to be a force multiplier that develops and enhances the skillset that development partners, contractors, and key trades bring to the project(s) you are overseeing. That means being a subject matter expert in the various cross functional elements of data center delivery and increasing the team's performance with that knowledge and commitment to alignment. Represent Anthropic in key technical and operational decisions required by partners during the development process, ensuring our infrastructure requirements are met while maintaining strong partnerships Drive seamless handoffs to operational state with heavy focus on engagement across networking and deployment teams, enabling rapid workload turn-ups and minimizing time-to-production Identify and mitigate risks throughout the delivery lifecycle, proactively addressing blockers that could impact timeline, cost, or technical requirements, and feed what you learn on site back into diligence and the playbook You may be a good fit if you: Have 8+ years of experience in preconstruction, development, or cost and commercial management on data center or other large mission-critical programs within EMEA, including time leading delivery on site. You won't have a big direct team to delegate to but will instead be able to treat the entire cross functional organizations around each deal and jobsite as your team. Have a track record of testing developer and contractor claims on cost, schedule, power and permitting against source documents, and of telling a deal team when a date does not hold up. Have taken time out of programs before construction started, and can show how. You read a native schedule fluently and know which levers in design, permitting, power and procurement move a date. Have shaped delivery terms in development, lease or construction agreements, working with legal teams, and have led tendering and bid analysis. You understand how cost and schedule flow through to the investment case. Have a strong understanding of the end to end (dirt to delivery) data center development process to include entitlements and permitting, planning and supply chain, execution, commissioning, and handover. You are not an administrator but an active player in the arena comfortable making decisions without the need to consult across multiple external parties. You should understand the nuances of data center design and construction across EMEA markets- who the players are, how power and permitting differ, what contractual norms get in the way of speed of delivery, how teams can be incentivized to build and deliver faster than normal. Have built or scaled a team or function, including directing third-party advisers. In this role you will often be on an island and responsible for your own destiny. You will have free rein to develop your own approaches with the mission guidance being your only bounds. No one will be there to empower your efforts, you will create your own influence by building relationships and diving in at all phases to deliver success. You must thrive operating with ambiguity and have a willingness to own outcomes, knowing that the buck stops with you. It's a bonus if you: Understand AI/ML infrastructure requirements, including high-density power and advanced cooling systems Have had preconstruction or leadership positions (Preconstruction Manager, General Superintendent, Project Manager) within a GC, EPC or developer on hyperscale data center projects or in self performance of hyperscale data center development projects. Prioritize extreme ownership and have the ability to create winning cultures across diverse teams and job sites. Are deeply familiar with lease negotiations, construction contracts, or real estate development processes and have strategies to move those arrangements from traditionally transaction and risk managed arrangements to collaborative efforts that align incentives around accelerated delivery of facilities. Have secured long-lead equipment or manufacturing capacity ahead of a signed deal, including through frame agreements or early funding arrangements. Have run quantitative schedule risk analysis, or built parametric cost benchmarks across a portfolio of sites. Speak additional European languages. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. Our customers include global media broadcasters, publishers, gaming companies and major film studios.
